generation_rules: Open the edit target and relevant original references with view_image before generation, and assign every input an explicit role.
Use G2 as the current v3.1 full-body and outfit reference, including the medium-grey ribbed socks and integrated silver pin.
Use S1 for the exact one-pin design: bright silver tone, slender straight bar, rounded tips, scale, tilt and character-left placement just above the ear.
P1 remains the original face, black-bob structure and drawing authority; P2 supplies the everyday closed-mouth smile. The small face in G2 does not replace these original face references.
P6 remains the inherited body-construction reference. Its navy sock color and absence of the pin are superseded by G2 and S1 for v3.1.
Preserve the healthy leg contours, original sock height and ribbed fit, blue-grey skirt, white shirt with blue-grey piping, and white sneakers shown in G2.
Later situation selections do not automatically change the primary reference roles.
Use the current black-bob v3.0 lineage; do not mix v1/v2 or the August v3.0 research design into this version.
